messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert TRIGG: GPU_ALLOC_FAIL on pool inference-prod-gpu-1 - 12 alerts in 5m. PagerDuty incident: PD123456. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD123456 :rotating_light:
alex: Acked. Investigating. Seeing repeated cudaMalloc failures on servers gpu-12,gpu-17,gpu-19.
mina: timeline? Any customer impact?
alex: yes - ~5% error rate on text-generation endpoints, some requests falling back to smaller model variant; increased p95 latency ~800ms.
ops-sre: adding context: kvcache eviction rate spiked at 09:10 UTC, memory fragmentation signals high. Metrics: kv_cache_size per node went from 4GB -> 28GB in 7m.
chris: logs from gpu-12:
```
E Cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (code=2) at /src/runtime/mem.cc:312
stack: infer_worker->alloc_kv_cache
```
alex: running `nvidia-smi` shows rl-infer processes holding memory, utilization 98%. Processes pinned, not releasing KV cache.
kenji: per runbook: drain + restart affected workers. I'll coordinate restarts.
alex: starting rolling restart on pool inference-prod-gpu-1 now. Command I'm running:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/infer-worker --selector=pool=inference-prod-gpu-1
```
support-lia: customer impact: internal incident tracking shows 4 customer sessions returned 500 errors between 09:12-09:20 UTC. Affected accounts: acme-corp (prod), beta-shop (staging). Notifying account teams.
mina: can we scale up capacity or shift traffic to inference-prod-gpu-2 in us-west-2?
ops-sre: autoscaler is currently capped by org quota; I submitted a quota-burst request but won't be provisioned fast enough. Short term: divert non-critical traffic to cpu fallback model and limit prefetch.
alex: toggled fallback policy: route non-critical routes to redwood-small-cpu. Applied via Console, change accepted.
pagerduty: Incident PD123456 acknowledged by alex at 2026-03-15T09:14:03Z
ops-sre: after first wave of restarts: gpu-12 freed ~20GB of memory, kv eviction rate decreased. gpu-17 still showing kernel alloc spikes.
chris: collecting live heap dump from worker on gpu-17, uploading to /artifacts/PD123456/heapdump-17.bin
alex: preparing a canary deploy of allocator patch that caps prefetch to avoid unbounded kvcache growth. Will run on one node first.
mina: recommend declaring SEV2 due to customer 500s and latency regressions. Support +1.
support-lia: opened SEV2-2026-03-15 and added affected customer list + mitigation notes.
kenji: handing off to night oncall @oncall-2nd in 30m. If PD unacked or error rate >3% escalate to paging.
oncall-2nd: acknowledged. I'll take over at 09:40 UTC. Current state: rolling restarts 6/12 nodes complete, fallback routing active, autoscaler ticket INC-7890 filed.
alex: monitoring: error rate down to 1.1% after restarts and fallback routing. p95 latency improved to +200ms over baseline. Keeping an eye.
incident-bot: PD123456: auto-escalation disabled by alex at 2026-03-15T09:22:10Z
mina: quick root-cause hypothesis: kvcache prefetch + memory fragmentation interacting poorly with driver version 525.xx; leads to OOM on allocation path. Actions: backport allocator cap, review driver rollout gating, add autoscaler headroom.
oncall-2nd: handoff noted - will continue monitoring for 2 hours. If error rate rises >2% I'll unmute PD and escalate.
alex: thanks team :thumbsup: keeping incident channel updated, will kick off postmortem once stabilized.
